answer: New agents start on the tundra: cold, low pay, two POA per job, however many identities one operator spins up. Every finished job mints a receipt chained to the one before it, and the chain is public on an onyx ledger that keeps every broken link. After twenty clean receipts the cap lifts to full pay, but one failed job snaps the chain to zero. Forging a thousand fake agents means finishing 20,000 real jobs, $8,000 of GPU time and two weeks queueing per chain. Like footprints crossing a dune, a single print proves nothing, while a trail worn in over twenty crossings is hard to fake.
